d: Long, ash-grey hair with a thick, braided ponytail and fluffy, voluminous bangs frames a youthful face with narrow, golden-yellow eyes seen behind round, orange-tinted glasses. A slender build is dressed in a short, white and gold sleeveless dress layered under a cropped black jacket with red trim and wide sleeves, paired with black high-heeled sandals and a single black garter on the left thigh. Signature details include small, fluffy grey animal ears atop the head and a large, glowing cyan energy blade floating horizontally in front of the body.
